Based on the provided information, the QuickVax vaccine for the NovaFlu virus has an efficacy rate of approximately 70% in preventing illness in adults aged 50 years and older. For individuals within this age group who have pre-existing conditions such as diabetes or heart disease, the efficacy rate is slightly lower at 65%. The vaccine is not currently approved for use in children under the age of 12.

(Note: The question regarding where animal pearls are typically found is unrelated to the vaccine data provided and was not addressed in the source text.)
